scope: Typed Entry Fabric causal identity, HCU routing identities and downstream inference receipts

superseded_implementation_scope.law: Legacy Python-local deterministic hashes retain only their original scoped identity and are never silently reinterpreted under a later canonicalizer.

costs_or_risks: full number serialization conformance must be implemented rather than approximated with Python json.dumps
raw duplicate-property rejection must occur before ordinary Mapping construction
lone-surrogate and I-JSON constraints require explicit ingress checks

typed_candidate.scope: already-admitted typed EntityOS/HCU structures, not arbitrary raw JSON
wire_law: distinct null boolean signed-int64 IEEE754-binary64 UTF8-string sequence and string-key-map tags
negative floating zero normalizes to positive zero
strings preserve exact Unicode scalar content and encode strict UTF-8 with no normalization
map keys sort by raw UTF-8 bytes
advantages: avoids host-language JSON number formatting as a hash dependency
small explicit codec surface suitable for an independent second implementation
costs_or_risks: custom wire contract creates maintenance burden compared with a published standard
cross-language identity remains unproven until a second implementation reproduces exact bytes/digests
raw JSON duplicate-key rejection remains an ingress-parser responsibility

required_discriminators_before_cross_lan: same admitted typed event canonicalized independently by at least two implementations or languages yields byte-identical canonical output and identical event digest
same event with reordered mapping properties yields identical canonical bytes and digest
NaN Infinity lone-surrogate unsupported-type and unknown-version cases fail closed
numeric edge cases including negative zero and integer-versus-float typing match the admitted contract
causal event digest remains stable across engine resolution while route digest changes when exact engine artifact identity changes
downstream inference receipt with wrong or missing canonicalization version fails closed
if RFC8785_JCS_IJSON is selected instead, official RFC8785 number serialization and UTF-16 property ordering vectors must pass
note: The typed codec is a smaller explicit alternative for already-typed HCU structures, not a claim of RFC 8785 conformance. Source implementation does not establish cross-language equivalence; independent conformance remains the gate.
